text:
ida: Quick sync on the safety-lattice idea for cutovers. Goal: a small lattice of checks (safety, isolation, rollback) to gate each modular slice.

omar: Sounds good. Can you summarize the three checks?

ida: Sure: 1) Safety = no cross-tenant shared state or explicit mitigation in place. 2) Isolation = perf/mem smoke and tenant-chaos pass. 3) Rollback = 2-step minimal rollback + fallback path validated.

sylvie: For Safety, how strict are we? Are read-only caches allowed?

ida: Read-only caches that are tenant-scoped are okay. Shared process caches without tenant keys are BLOCKING. We'll add a short detection checklist.

rahul: We should add an "escape hatch" column: temporary read-only shim that prevents writes to legacy path during canary. Makes some migrations easier.

ida: Good idea. Add "shim_available" boolean. If shim=false and safety=questionable, block.

infra-bot: Reminder: add smoke job template to docs/observability/smoke-jobs.md before scheduling canaries.

omar: For Isolation tests, recommend a 30m tenant-chaos window during the 25% canary. Will catch noisy neighbors.

sylvie: Agree. Also require a quick dependency map per slice so we know downstream consumers. If a consumer isn't on the migration list, block.

ida: We'll add a "consumer_registrations" row with required signoffs. If external consumer => product approval required.

rahul: On Rollback validation: automated rollback must be tested in dry-run mode once before production cut. Not optional.

ida: Agreed. Add a dry-run milestone to the playbook. Also adding an "owner_on_call" field per row that must be populated.

omar: One more: post-cut KPI window = 14 days for critical slices, 30 days for medium. Capture error budget and correctness signals.

sylvie: Can we add a small template for the rollback snippet in the matrix? Something one-line per slice.

ida: Yes will add a 1-line rollback capsule. Example: "flip-route-header -> revert pool -> clear cache TTL".

infra-bot: Action logged: safety_lattice_matrix -> draft_created.

ida: Action items: 1) ida: publish matrix CSV + playbook PR by EOD. 2) teams: fill consumer_registrations + owner_on_call within 4 days. 3) eng-sre: provide smoke job template and dry-run checklist. 4) product: confirm external consumer windows.

omar: I'll help draft the dependency map template.

ida: Thanks all. Will post PR link when ready.

rahul: :thumbsup:
